phases.title: Read the nursing college, tenancy, child-benefit and transit rules and gather dated rental examples
phases.note: Licensing routes and fees, rents and deposits, schools, health cover, transit
phases.judgment: It did not assume the usual route: Alberta’s nursing college offers other ways to confirm competency, so the national credential assessment and a bridging programme are not treated as mandatory. It also found that working as a care aide in the meantime needs its own separate registration.

phases.title: Build the guide with the licensing timeline, rent comparison and six-month cash table
phases.judgment: It showed the shortfall plainly instead of softening it: the two-bedroom plan costs $4,017 a month, savings last 3.68 months without income, and six months leave a $9,302 gap. Rents are labelled as examples, and car, winter-gear and 2027 fare prices are marked unverified.

phases.title: Independent check of every money figure, plus desktop and phone layout tests
phases.judgment: The independent colleague recomputed every money figure and found them all correct. It also flagged that the licensing exam fee depends on the registration date, so the plan keeps the higher $570 as a cautious budget instead of assuming the $360 that applies if registration is completed before 1 February 2027.
